# Della Spa

> Beauty spa treatment di Jl. Karma Kandara No.41, Ungasan, Kuta
> Selatan, Badung, Bali. Menyediakan Balinese massage, Swedish
> massage, hot stone massage, facial, manicure, pedicure, body
> scrub, dan paket treatment dua jam. Buka setiap hari 10.00–21.00
> WITA. Rating Google 4,8 dari 11 ulasan. Booking via WhatsApp
> +62 812-3610-9511.

## Layanan & Harga

- [Treatment & Harga](https://dellaspabali.com/treatments.html): daftar lengkap 20+ treatment — body massage mulai 300k/jam, nail 250k–400k, facial & body 200k–300k.
- [Paket Treatment](https://dellaspabali.com/packages.html): 2 paket resmi 2 jam, masing-masing 600k, kombinasi massage + scrub + facial/masker.
- [Balinese Massage di Ungasan](https://dellaspabali.com/balinese-massage-ungasan.html): treatment andalan, 300k/jam.

## Booking

- [Booking via WhatsApp](https://dellaspabali.com/booking.html): pilih treatment, pesan WhatsApp tersusun otomatis. Tidak ada sistem reservasi online terpisah.

## Informasi

- [Kontak & Lokasi](https://dellaspabali.com/contact.html): alamat lengkap, jam operasional, peta.
- [Tentang Della Spa](https://dellaspabali.com/about.html): filosofi treatment dan suasana.
- [Galeri](https://dellaspabali.com/gallery.html): foto suasana dan detail treatment.
- [Pertanyaan Umum](https://dellaspabali.com/faq.html): jawaban seputar reservasi, durasi, dan lokasi.
- [Spa di Ungasan & Uluwatu](https://dellaspabali.com/spa-ungasan-uluwatu.html): lokasi strategis dekat Pantai Melasti dan Pandawa.

## Catatan

Della Spa tidak menawarkan layanan home service atau in-villa
sebagai layanan resmi. Semua treatment dilakukan di lokasi,
Jl. Karma Kandara No.41, Ungasan.
